setup: Why did the scarecrow win an award?
punchline: Because he was outstanding in his field.
prompt: A friendly scarecrow with a straw hat stands proudly in the middle of a golden wheat field at sunset, holding a shiny gold trophy. He looks into the camera, raises the trophy, and says in a cheerful dad voice: "I'm outstanding in my field." Wheat sways in the breeze.

setup: What do you call a fake noodle?
prompt: A single spaghetti noodle wearing tiny fake glasses with a big plastic nose and mustache sneaks across a kitchen counter next to a pot of pasta. It stops, turns to the camera, lifts the disguise slightly, and whispers: "I'm an impasta."

setup: What do you call a bear with no teeth?
prompt: A big friendly brown bear sits in a sunny forest clearing, looks into the camera and gives a wide, completely toothless grin, showing only pink gums. It says with a goofy chuckle: "I'm a gummy bear."

setup: Why don't eggs tell jokes?
prompt: A carton of a dozen white eggs with little cartoon faces sits on a kitchen counter. One egg tells a joke and all the eggs burst out laughing so hard that hairline cracks spread across their shells. One egg gasps to the camera: "Stop, you're cracking us up!"

setup: What do you call a fish wearing a bowtie?
prompt: An orange goldfish wearing a tiny black bowtie and a monocle swims up to the glass of an elegant aquarium in a fancy wood-paneled library. It adjusts its monocle with a fin and says in a posh voice: "Sofishticated."

setup: Why did the cookie go to the doctor?
prompt: A chocolate chip cookie sits on an examination table in a tiny doctor's office, a little thermometer in its mouth, crumbs falling off its edges. It looks sadly at the camera and sighs: "Doc, I feel crummy."

setup: What do you call a sleeping bull?
prompt: A huge black bull sleeps in a green pasture, snoring loudly. Every snore rumbles like a construction machine and pushes a pile of dirt forward like a bulldozer blade. A farmer leans into frame and whispers to the camera: "Bulldozer."

setup: Why did the golfer bring two pairs of pants?
punchline: In case he got a hole in one.
prompt: A dad golfer in loud plaid pants celebrates on a sunny golf green as his ball drops into the cup, then notices a big hole torn in the seat of his pants. He pulls a second pair of pants from his golf bag, grins at the camera and says: "Hole in one."

setup: What do you call a dinosaur with an extensive vocabulary?
prompt: A green dinosaur wearing round reading glasses sits in a leather armchair in a cozy library, flipping through a giant book with its tiny arms. It looks up at the camera and says in a refined voice: "Splendid. Magnificent. Superb. I'm a thesaurus."

setup: Why do cows wear bells?
prompt: A brown and white dairy cow stands in an alpine meadow and squeezes an old rubber bicycle horn, but it makes no sound. Annoyed, it shakes its head and its big cowbell clangs loudly. The cow looks at the camera and says: "My horns don't work."

setup: What did the ocean say to the beach?
prompt: A turquoise ocean wave rolls toward a sunny sandy beach. As it reaches the shore, the crest of the wave forms a giant friendly hand made of water that waves hello at the camera, then splashes down onto the sand. Seagulls call in the background.

setup: What do you call a pig that does karate?
prompt: A pink pig in a white karate gi and black belt stands in a dojo, bows, then karate chops a wooden board clean in half. It strikes a pose toward the camera and shouts: "Pork chop! Hi-yah!"

setup: Why did the bicycle fall over?
prompt: A red bicycle leans against a brick wall on a quiet street at dusk. Its two tires sag, it lets out a big sleepy yawn, and it slowly tips over onto the sidewalk. A sleepy voice mumbles: "I'm just two tired." Soft snoring follows.

setup: What do you call an alligator in a vest?
prompt: An alligator wearing a tweed vest and a detective's deerstalker hat stands on its hind legs in a misty swamp, peering through a large magnifying glass. It leans toward the camera, the lens magnifying its eye, and says in a serious voice: "I'm an investigator."

setup: How does a penguin build its house?
prompt: An emperor penguin in an icy Antarctic landscape squeezes a bottle of glue onto a block of ice and presses it onto a half-built igloo. It turns to the camera, holds up the glue bottle, and says proudly: "Igloos it together."

setup: What do you call a snowman with a six-pack?
prompt: A snowman with a carrot nose and a gold chain stands in a snowy park and flexes, showing off a perfectly sculpted six-pack of snow abs and muscular snow arms. He winks at the camera and says in a deep voice: "Abdominal snowman."

setup: Why don't skeletons fight each other?
prompt: Two goofy cartoon skeletons face off in a boxing ring with oversized red gloves. They look down at their empty ribcages, shrug at each other, and drop their gloves. One turns to the camera and says: "We don't have the guts."

setup: What do you call a lazy kangaroo?
prompt: A kangaroo lounges on a cozy living room couch holding a TV remote, with a bag of chips and a whole potato poking out of its pouch. It yawns, looks at the camera and says lazily: "Pouch potato."

setup: What does a lemon say when it answers the phone?
prompt: A bright yellow lemon with a cheerful face sits next to an old rotary phone on a sunny kitchen table. The phone rings, the lemon picks up the handset, holds it to its side, and says brightly into it: "Yellow!"

setup: Why did the coffee file a police report?
prompt: A steaming cup of coffee with worried eyes sits in a police station interview room as a detective takes notes. It sniffles and says to the camera: "I got mugged." A coffee mug in a striped burglar mask sneaks past in the background.
